authorization: User accepted the proposed PF500 -> PF500-K1 -> PF500-K1K2 ablation followed by a separate measurement-noise R comparison, saying 'lam di'.
purpose: Determine whether existing PF techniques and the source of measurement-height scaling improve tracking on the existing development split.

dataset.name: UA-DETRAC
dataset.selection: Reuse historical dev12. This development set has been observed and tuned on before.

design.measurement_height_prediction_definition: Weighted mean height of particles immediately before update_particles assimilates the measurement, lower-bounded by the existing positive-height epsilon. The same resulting R is used for Gaussian likelihood, degeneracy criterion and K1 proposal/weight.
design.fixed_parameters: Existing PF500, EKF and UKF tracker YAML values. K2=1.0 comes from the prior R48 development selection. No new hyperparameter sweep.
design.association: Existing ByteTrack association for every filter.

preconditions: Read-only GT/cache preflight with hashes and video counts.
Default observation mode preserves original outputs and RNG state in meaningful fixtures.
Prediction mode checked against Gaussian reference including K1 and weighted priors.
Smoke on MVI_20052 and MVI_20062 completes all 21 runs before full dev12.
Repeated PF seed output matches MOT bytes on smoke.
Record source/config/protocol hashes before tracking and verify before analysis.

analysis.aggregation: TrackEval COMBINED separately for each seed, then arithmetic mean across seeds. Also report seed range.
analysis.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap by video, 5000 samples, RNG seed 0. Confidence intervals descriptive across the predeclared comparisons.
primary_comparisons: prediction minus observation within each of the three PF recipes
analysis.references: Report all six PF variants against CV and EKF, with UKF as an additional descriptive reference.
analysis.prediction_error: Descriptive preassociation center error divided by GT height, linked to prior output with one-to-one IoU>=0.5 matching. Missing-observation bins 0, 1-2, 3-8, >=9. Include coverage and survivor-selection limitations.
analysis.time: Concurrent tracking wall times describe resource use only. A separate fixed replay run sequentially is needed for comparative runtime.
analysis.interpretation: Development evidence only. Dataset-specific results do not establish general superiority or constitute a locked final benchmark.
